svg.text: ENTERPRISE MEETING INTELLIGENCE, SPEAKER DIARIZATION & CRM/JIRA SYNC ARCHITECTURE
Per-Track RTP + Voiceprint Diarization (1.4% DER) + Hotword Boost + Staged CRM Sync
100,000 Meeting Hours/Mo: Tier 1 Mixed MP3 + Blind CRM Write ($195K/mo) vs. Tier 3 Raw Audio LLM ($420K/mo) vs. Tier 4 ($24.5K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1 & 3 Traps: Buyer/Seller Swap & CRM Pollution
1. Single-Channel Mixed Audio Without Track/Voiceprint (22.4% DER):
• Confuses what the customer requested with what the sales rep
promised, especially when 4 people share a conference room mic!
2. Generic Unboosted ASR Vocabulary (28.5% SKU/Jargon Error):
• Transcribes proprietary product codes & executive names into
homophone gibberish that LLM post-correction cannot recover
3. Blind Direct CRM / Jira Auto-Write (19.2% False Action Items):
• Turns casual brainstorming into committed Salesforce deal dates
Production Failure Impact (100,000 Meeting Hours/Mo):
• Speaker Error (DER): 22.4% | SKU/Term Error: 28.5%
• False CRM/Jira Action Items: 19.2% (Tier 3 Audio LLM: $420K/mo)
• Monthly Compute + Sales Cleanup Cost: $195,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: Per-Track RTP + Voiceprint + Hotword + Staged Card
1. Per-Participant RTP Streams + ECAPA-TDNN Room Voiceprints:
• Uses Teams/Zoom per-user audio tracks + enrolled voiceprints inside
conference rooms to cut speaker error from 22.4% to 1.4%!
2. Pre-Call Calendar & CRM Hotword Boosting (2.2% SKU Error):
• Injects invitee names, Account SKUs & project codes into ASR
decoder shallow-fusion phrase list before the meeting starts
3. Timestamp Quote Anchor + 1-Click Adaptive Card CRM Gate:
• Requires verbatim [14:22] quote + rep 1-click approval (0.4% noise)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Speaker Error (DER): 1.4% | Domain SKU Accuracy: 97.8% (2.2% err)
• False CRM/Jira Sync Rate: 0.4% (Timestamp-Anchored Approval Card)
• Monthly Total TCO: $24,500 / mo (-87.4% vs Tier 1, -94.2% vs Tier 3)
Provenance: synthetic + anonymized_reported (independently_reproduced=false) | turbo998/ai-infra-research
